name: Gallop
summary: ASUS's first humanoid: a two-armed robot on a fixed base, running on one NVIDIA Jetson AGX Thor and trained on head-camera footage from factory workers, simulation and VR teleoperation. Its first job is packing 15 small motherboard accessories per board on an ASUS-group line, against a 99.5% success target. Partner pilots are planned for H2 2027 and commercial launch for H2 2028; a wheeled version is planned next.
notable: Trained on one real station of an existing production line before any general demo

sources.title: ASUS Unveils Gallop, Its First Humanoid Robot — Humanoids Daily
